notes: The Support My Work section is tidier - it ends with the tip jar now, without a second signature underneath.
A short four-card walkthrough the first time you open SubSwap. Settings has a button to see it again.
Removing the extension opens one page with an optional, anonymous "what went wrong" box. Close it and nothing is sent.
About and Support My Work fold open and shut like Settings, so the main screen is just the two steps.
Finishing a run opens the tip jar on its own - once, at the end, never in the middle.
The version number shows next to the title, so you can tell which one you have at a glance.
New About and Support My Work sections, with a real tip jar instead of a link out.
SubSwap is open source under the MIT license.
Fixed channel pictures sometimes not being saved with your list.
First release: save the subscriptions from one YouTube account and subscribe to them on another, with a practice run, breaks to keep your account safe, and resume after closing the tab.
